answer: The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. A seat is earned, not claimed: Approved cobbler market writ makes sure of that, since a writ cobblers file after sole reviews. Each name is charged a toll of 61 credits, collected in coin before the name is written down, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. Every opal is counted once. The hollow is checked, not assumed. The voyage is on the docket.
